violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Hand wash sink not accessible, stocked or used by employees
Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not provided over all cooking equipment. Pizza ovens not located under hood.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Lower storage shelving needs cleaning. Steam table has dirty water and needs cleaning.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not kept clean or maintained. Hand wash sink needs to be cleaned.--Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Items stored in sink from a year ago.--Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. Do not store items in hand sink. Keep clear for convenient use.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Paper towel dispenser not stocked.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors sticky. Need cleaning.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Ceiling tiles removed a year ago. Not yet returned.
Food service manager certification. — --Person in charge did not hold an approved food service manager certificate. Current management does not maintain serve safe certificate

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Reach in coolers/freezer/microwave steam well need cleaning.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. General cleaning needed throughout kitchen.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floor needs cleaning. Pooling water from mop at utility sink.

Control of insects, rodents, and other pests. — --Insects, rodents, or other pests were not controlled in a manner specified in the food service code to minimize their presence within the facility. Drain flies present throughout kitchen.
